title: BRA Espec Santander II 8h
description:
BRA Espec Santander II 8h – Brazil

Se você tem vontade de crescer e aprender sempre, e tem paixão em lidar com pessoas, esse pode ser o seu lugar! O Santander é um ecossistema em crescimento, que tem o propósito de contribuir para que pessoas e negócios prosperem. Aqui é o espaço para criar o novo, questionar e desafiar o mercado. É ter a urgência do agora e do futuro alinhados, para atender ao cliente sempre da melhor forma. É fazer parte de uma empresa global, que preza pela diversidade em todas as suas dimensões e que valoriza a cultura de horizontalidade dos cargos.

No Santander temos a cultura de horizontalidade e nelapraticamos 4 clusters: Especialista, Líder, Head e Sócio.

Temos uma vaga para você se tornar Especialista Santander, onde você será encarreirado como Especialista, sendo o principal conhecedor da sua área.

Responsabilidades

  • Vivência com vendas.

Se isso te chama, vem para o Santander!

Oportunidade – Bolsa - Biologia Molecular e Biologia Sintética de Microrganismos

A Biotech Business, startup dedicada à criação de soluções biológicas inovadoras para a agroindústria, está em busca de um(a) profissional para atuar em projetos de biologia molecular, biologia sintética e construção de cepas microbianas.

Nosso propósito é transformar a agricultura por meio da ciência, da inovação e do desenvolvimento de tecnologias regenerativas e sustentáveis.

Valorizamos pessoas adaptáveis, colaborativas e com mentalidade de aprendizado contínuo, que enxerguem desafios como oportunidades de crescimento e evolução.

Oportunidade Bolsa

Nível: Mestrado ou Doutorado

Duração da bolsa: 12 meses

Valor da bolsa: R$5.200,00 (Mestre) / R$5.850,00 (Doutor)

Responsabilidades
  • Condução de experimentos laboratoriais em microbiologia e biologia molecular;
  • Construção, clonagem e caracterização de cepas microbianas de interesse agrícola;
  • Aplicação de técnicas avançadas de biologia molecular (PCR, RT-qPCR, clonagem, sequenciamento);
  • Desenvolvimento e aplicação de ferramentas de biologia sintética;
  • Utilização de técnicas de edição gênica, com ênfase em sistemas CRISPR/Cas, para otimização de cepas;
  • Triagem, seleção e engenharia de microrganismos promissores;
  • Condução de ensaios fermentativos em escala de bancada;

  • Apoio na elaboração de projetos de PD&I (diferencial).

  • Título de Mestre ou Doutor na área de execução do projeto;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em microbiologia e biologia molecular;
  • Experiência comprovada em construção e engenharia de cepas microbianas;
  • Domínio de técnicas de engenharia genética (clonagem, vetores de expressão, transformação, etc.);
  • Experiência em edição gênica (CRISPR/Cas, knockout, knock-in, entre outras);
  • Perfil organizado, criativo, proativo e com foco em solução de problemas.
Diferenciais
  • Experiência em biologia sintética aplicada a microrganismos;
  • Experiência em construção de cepas para aplicações industriais ou agrícolas;

Join to apply for the Gerente de Parcerias Estratégicas Público e Privado - Campinas e região role at AbbVie

Descrição da empresa
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas – immunology, oncology, neuroscience, and eye care – and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at Follow @abbvie on X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn and Tik Tok.

Descrição da vaga

A função de Gerente de Parcerias Estratégicas Público e Privado tem como objetivo implementar os planos estratégicos junto as contas chave de Acesso ao Mercado.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Elaboração e execução dos planos de contas chaves juntos às principais instituições de saúde, nos mercados público e privado, visando minimizar as barreiras de acesso ao mercado através da ampliação do acesso dos pacientes aos nossos medicamentos, de forma ética e científica, e o cumprimento das metas de vendas de todo o portfolio de produtos;
  • Desenvolver e implementar/executar planos de contas-chave detalhados para as principais instituições de saúde (Secretarias de Saúde, Operadoras de Saúde), identificando os principais influenciadores e tomadores de decisão;
  • Engajar os principais gestores de saúde para garantir acesso de todo o portfolio de produtos da empresa junto às Secretarias Estaduais, Hospitais Militares, Operadoras de Saúde e Providers;
  • Implementação de contratos de fornecimento do Portfolio Abbvie;
  • Elaboração de estratégias para manter atas vigentes dos produtos Abbvie demandados em cada instituição/estado (Militares, CACONs e SES);
  • Liderar iniciativas junto aos gestores públicos para planejamento de pautas dos produtos incorporados no MOH;
  • Realizar gestão de fluxos de atestos nas SES para liquidação dos títulos pendentes pelo MOH;
  • Trabalhar em sinergia e liderança com as áreas de vendas, marketing e médica integrando as diferentes áreas para otimizar os resultados das ações de acesso ao mercado.

Qualificações

  • Superior completo;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Experiência sólida na indústria farmacêutica;
  • Experiência em vendas institucionais, negociação e relacionamento com gestores de saúde público e privada;
  • Conhecimento sobre Saúde Suplementar;
  • Conhecimento com trâmites dos órgãos governamentais e políticas de saúde;
  • Conhecimento Técnico em Acesso (Leis, Portarias, ANS, CONITEC, Conass, Conasems, fluxos de acesso);
  • Experiência e habilidade com Pacote Office (Power Point, Excel, Word);
  • Capacidade analítica, leitura de dados e extração de insights;
  • Experiência como Consultor ou Gerente Distrital será considerado um diferencial;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens - Interior de SP e Sul de Minas.

Informações adicionais
A AbbVie é uma empresa de oportunidades igualitárias e está empenhada em operar com integridade, impulsionando a inovação, transformando vidas e servindo a nossa comunidade. Empregador de Igualdade de Oportunidade/Veteranos/Deficientes.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack .Net
description:
Company Overview

SEW is the #1 Energy and Water Cloud Platform, providing cloud-based Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions for Digital Customer Engagement, Field Workforce Engagement, and Smart AI/Machine Learning to the Energy and Utility sector. We empower utilities to enhance customer service, optimize operational efficiency, and maximize return on investments through the SEW platform applications leveraging mobile, AI, Machine Learning, and Cloud technologies.

Searching for your dream job? At SEW, we strive to help our employees find passion and purpose. Join us in changing the way the world uses energy and water and become part of our innovative and talented team!


Position Overview

We are looking for a Mid Level Full Stack .Net Developer with good experience with C# and Angular to join our dynamic engineering team. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain robust web and mobile applications that integrate seamlessly with SEW’s platform. The ideal candidate will be passionate about building scalable and efficient software solutions and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.


Key Responsibilities

Application Development:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable web and mobile applications using modern frameworks and technologies.
  • Build responsive front-end interfaces that deliver exceptional user experiences.
  • Develop efficient and secure back-end services and APIs.

Analysis and Reporting:

  • Perform thorough analysis of complex data and recommend actionable strategies.
  • Develop complex database queries in SQL/TSQL and NoSQL.
  • Translate client requirements to technical architectural specifications and communicate this to delivery teams and clients.

Collaboration:

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and other developers, to define and implement solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews to ensure high-quality software development.

System Optimization:

  • Optimize application performance to ensure scalability and reliability.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve technical issues promptly.

Innovation and Best Practices:

  • Define data architecture requirements for cross-product integration within and across cloud-based platforms.
  • Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.
  • Advocate for and implement best practices in software development, including testing, security, and CI/CD processes.
  • Write test plans and test cases to ensure application integrity is maintained.


Education and Experience Requirements

  • Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Engineering, or a related field.
  • Previous experience in software development and product deployment.
  • Hands-on experience with .Net Core, .Net Framework, Angular, Entity Framework, Git, Unit Tests and Pipelines.
  • Strong technical documentation skills.
  • Expertise in MySQL, Oracle, or MS SQL Server (SAP HANA is a plus).
  • Experience with cloud architecture, including AWS, Azure, and Google (SAP BTP is a plus).
  • Effectively translate data modeling and BI requirements into the design process.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent human relations and documentation skills.
  • Strong ability to interpret customer and market insights and conduct data analysis.
  • Fluent English is required; Spanish is a plus.


Why Join SEW?

  • Be part of a mission-driven organization creating impactful solutions for the energy and water sectors.
  • Collaborate with a talented and innovative team on cutting-edge projects.
  • Enjoy opportunities for professional growth and skill development.
  • Work in a culture that values diversity, creativity, and collaboration.


SEW is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Como líder funcional no design de jornadas e segmentação de audiência, esse profissional é responsável por transformar insights de consumidores e objetivos de negócio em estratégias avançadas de CRM e Fidelidade , abrangendo múltiplos canais e mercados.

1) Marketing Direto e Ativação de Audiências

2) Dados, Mensuração e Otimização

  • Definir KPIs e métricas de sucesso para programas de CRM, incluindo engajamento, conversão e incremento de receita.
  • Integrar insights de performance em novas iterações estratégicas, identificando oportunidades de teste e aprendizado e lacunas de desempenho .
  • Trabalhar em parceria com líderes de CDP/CDNA para aprimorar a lógica de segmentação e as táticas de personalização orientadas por dados.

3) Alinhamento Multifuncional e Suporte a Stakeholders

  • Atuar como elo estratégico de CRM para as equipes de marca e mercados locais, aconselhando sobre viabilidade e melhores práticas .
  • Guiar a priorização de jornadas e segmentos de consumidores com base em impacto de negócio, nível de personalização e oportunidade de audiência.


Experiência e Competências Necessárias:


  • 5 a 7 anos de experiência em funções estratégicas de CRM ou Marketing Direto, com expertise comprovada em marketing de ciclo de vida e personalização em escala .
  • Domínio em personalização orientada por dados , design de jornadas complexas e lógica de segmentação .

  • Conhecimento de arquitetura CDP/CDNA , lógica de ativação e fluxos de integração de audiências.
  • Familiaridade com mecânicas de fidelidade, jornadas de indicação, estratégias de gamificação e modelos de engajamento similares.
  • Perfil analítico , capaz de interpretar resultados de campanhas e traduzir insights em ajustes estratégicos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de gestão de stakeholders e capacidade de sintetizar informações de marca, dados, tecnologia e times globais em estratégias de CRM acionáveis .

Qualificações Desejáveis:

title: Public Relations Manager - LATAM
description:
About Cooler Master

Cooler Master is a global computer hardware manufacturer founded in 1992 in Taiwan. The company is known for its award-winning PC components, including cases, power supplies, cooling solutions, and accessories.


In addition to retail product lines, Cooler Master also serves as an OEM partner to major technology brands worldwide. The company has grown steadily through a strong focus on innovation, design, and user-driven product development. Headquartered in Taipei, Cooler Master operates manufacturing facilities in China and maintains regional offices across the globe.


Role Overview

Lead public relations for Latin America (LATAM) to elevate Cooler Master’s visibility across key markets such as Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, and Chile.

You’ll manage PR execution for launches and ongoing brand activations—aligning local media, translating technical information into engaging stories, and ensuring consistent communication with global and regional marketing teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own the LATAM PR Plan – Develop and execute the regional PR calendar and embargo plan; ensure alignment with global launches and LATAM sales priorities.

  • Coordinate Product Reviews – Manage the sample allocation, delivery, and follow-up process with regional media outlets.
  • Partner Collaboration – Drive joint PR opportunities with distributors, e-commerce partners, and brand collaborators.
  • Content Localization – Adapt global press materials for LATAM audiences to ensure cultural and linguistic accuracy.
  • Monitor & Report – Track press coverage, analyze media performance metrics, and deliver post-launch summaries.
  • Maintain Compliance – Ensure consistent application of embargoes, NDA terms, and authorized content usage.


Qualifications

  • Education : Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or related field.
  • Experience : 5–8+ years in tech, consumer electronics, or gaming PR across LATAM. Proven track record in media relations and launch management.
  • Regional Expertise :
  • Strong understanding of LATAM media ecosystem and regional communication styles.
  • Existing relationships with major tech and gaming outlets.
  • Language Skills :
  • Fluent in English and either Portuguese or Spanish (bilingual proficiency preferred).
  • Execution & Measurement :
  • Strong organizational skills, ability to manage multiple launches.
  • Familiarity with PR metrics such as share of voice and media reach.


Who You Are

  • A proactive communicator with high accountability and attention to detail.
  • Skilled at relationship-building across diverse markets and cultures.
  • Confident managing embargoes, timelines, and media expectations.
  • Adaptable and independent, yet collaborative with global teammates.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About the Client

Our client is a global technology company specialized in large-scale cloud infrastructure, automation of distributed systems, and deep integration between hardware and software.

The engineering environment is highly technical, fast-paced, and built around autonomy, ownership, and solving complex infrastructure challenges at global scale.


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Infrastructure Engineer with a strong software engineering background and solid experience in automating complex infrastructure environments.

This is a high-impact, product-focused role , responsible for building tools, automation layers, APIs, and workflows that will be directly consumed by the company’s customers — not only internal teams.

This is not a traditional DevOps/Platform position focused on provisioning resources internally.

Here, you will be designing and engineering infrastructure automation as product , interacting with hardware, clusters, and low-level systems that power a global cloud offering.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop tools, automations, APIs, and infrastructure workflows used directly by end customers.
  • Build automation layers that interact with physical hardware and low-level components (state management, provisioning logic, control sequences, etc.).
  • Create and maintain internal backends and integrations linking services, infrastructure, and the core platform.
  • Leverage programming languages — especially Python — to design robust and scalable automation solutions.
  • Work on the automation behind global infrastructure and distributed clusters.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions and architectural decisions.
  • Identify opportunities for improvement within the platform and proactively propose solutions.


Technical Requirements

  • Senior-level experience in software development , especially with Python.
  • Strong background in infrastructure automation and distributed environments.
  • Experience working with hardware , data centers, bare-metal environments, or infrastructure-heavy companies.
  • Solid understanding of APIs, internal workflows, provisioning automation, and backend integrations.
  • Ability to work in low-level contexts involving hardware components and state management.
  • Proven experience building solutions from scratch , not only executing predefined tasks.


Cultural & Behavioral Profile

  • High autonomy: must be able to discover opportunities, define approaches, and drive solutions independently.
  • Seniority and maturity to operate within a team of highly experienced engineers.
  • Hands-on, proactive mindset, with strong ownership and problem-solving orientation.
  • Experience in fast-paced environments (startups or mixed small/large company backgrounds).
  • Curiosity and flexibility to learn new technologies and navigate cross-disciplinary areas.


English Requirement

  • Advanced English is mandatory , as the leadership and part of the engineering team are international.


What Will Not Fit

  • Junior or mid-level professionals.
  • Candidates who only worked in slow, highly structured corporate environments.
  • Profiles focused solely on execution or maintenance (not creation).
  • Professionals who depend heavily on direction and lack technical autonomy.


Contract Model

  • PJ / Contractor (LLC) — engagement through independent contractor arrangement.
  • The candidate must be legally able to invoice through a company (LLC or equivalent).


Work Model

  • Remote (remote-friendly).
  • The company has no restrictions regarding location, as long as the candidate meets performance expectations and availability for team collaboration.


Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct impact on the core product , not just internal tooling.
  • Unique combination of software + hardware + global infrastructure engineering .
  • High autonomy and opportunity to design new components from scratch.
  • Collaboration with a senior, highly technical engineering team.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a Full-Stack Data Engineer to join our Mobile Applications department. This is a hybrid role that combines data engineering with data science overlap, giving you full ownership of the data lifecycle — from ingestion to transformation, analysis, and storytelling.

You will build and optimize scalable pipelines, ingest mobile app data from diverse sources, ensure infrastructure reliability, and deliver insights that directly influence how our apps grow. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics, equally capable of writing production-grade pipelines and uncovering meaningful trends in user behavior.


Key Responsibilities


Data Infrastructure & Pipelines

  • Build and maintain scalable, end-to-end pipelines across cloud environments. Ingest and transform data from files, APIs, mobile telemetry (Firebase, Amplitude, Google Analytics), and external databases into centralized stores.
  • Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Implement data quality monitoring, governance policies, and best practices for privacy, security, and compliance.
  • Participate in technical architecture discussions, contributing expertise on scalable, efficient data systems.


Analytics & Insights

  • Conduct exploratory and advanced analysis using SQL, Python, and statistical methods.
  • Collaborate with Analysts, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Support experimentation and A/B testing by ensuring clean, reliable datasets and analyzing results.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that influence mobile product strategy, user acquisition, and retention.


Collaboration & Best Practices

  • Engage in peer code reviews to uphold high standards of quality and maintainability.
  • Work cross-functionally with software engineering and business teams to ensure data solutions align with company priorities.
  • Document pipelines, workflows, and methodologies to foster reusability and knowledge sharing.


Who You Are


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role focused on data infrastructure and pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency in Python (or a similar programming language such as Java or C#).
  • Experience with AWS (Redshift, RDS, S3) and Google Cloud (BigQuery, Firebase) for managing cloud-based databases and analytics tools.
  • Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, or similar).
  • Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ELT/ETL best practices, and dimensional modeling. Experience with version control systems (e.g., GitHub).
  • Excellent communicator who can bridge technical depth with clear storytelling for non-technical stakeholders.

title: Java Developer
description:

A strong command of Java 8 and hands-on experience with the ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) are essential for this role, as you will be deeply involved in log validation, performance optimization, and application stability.

Required Qualifications:

  • Strong understanding of Tomcat server configuration and deployments.
  • Experience developing scalable applications with Spring Boot 1.5.x .

  • Solid knowledge of UI frameworks (JSP, jQuery, AngularJS).
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, particularly in debugging, log validation, and application migration.
  • Strong English communication skills and ability to work effectively in distributed teams.

A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: Linguistics Expert
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


About the role:


We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented linguist to support AI training initiatives and linguistic content creation. This role is ideal for someone with a strong academic background in linguistics (syntax, semantics, pragmatics, morphology, phonology, sociolinguistics, etc.) and a passion for language, technology, and clear communication. You will play a crucial role in shaping the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and NLP-based systems through high-quality linguistic data curation, annotation, and evaluation.


Job Title: Linguistics Expert – AI Training & Content Writing



Key Responsibilities:


  • Create or edit linguistically- rich content including grammar guides, syntactic analyses, usage explanations, or examples for NLP pipelines.
  • Identify and resolve issues related to ambiguity, bias, and grammaticality.
  • Perform quality assurance (QA) on model outputs for fluency, tone, factual accuracy, and language appropriateness.
  • Annotate linguistic datasets with syntactic, semantic, or pragmatic labels.
  • Support internal teams by conducting linguistic research and summarizing findings.
  • Apply linguistic knowledge to evaluate model behavior, error patterns, and generalization issues.


Qualifications:

  • Deep understanding of linguistic theory and language structure.
  • Experience with one or more of the following is a plus: computational linguistics, corpus analysis, language data annotation, LLM training.
  • Strong writing, editing, and communication skills.


Next Steps

To proceed further in the evaluation process, you will need to complete two assessments:

  • Assessment Test
  • Evaluates your linguistic and analytical skills
  • Link:



  • Versant English Proficiency Test
  • Focuses on assessing your spoken and written English proficiency
  • A C1 or C2 level is required to qualify


Once both assessments are successfully completed, you will be eligible for onboarding.

  • Language test


Action Required: XConnect Registration

You will also receive an invitation to our internal job platform, XConnect . Please take a few minutes to register and complete your profile. All project onboarding, communication, and documentation are managed through this platform.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
The Senior Talent Acquisition Partner plays a key role in driving hiring success across Engineering, Product, and Go-To-Market (GTM) teams in the LATAM region. This role operates within client’s global Talent Acquisition organization and partners closely with business leaders to develop and execute effective hiring strategies.


It requires a high level of autonomy, strong stakeholder management, and a consultative approach to ensure high-quality, timely hires in a competitive market. The Senior Talent Acquisition Partner helps shape hiring plans, advise on talent trends, and champion client’s growth across LATAM.


Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Manage full-cycle recruitment across Engineering, Product, and GTM roles in the LATAM region — from intake through offer.
  • Partner closely with hiring managers, HR Business Partners, and senior leaders to define needs, build strategies, and drive hiring outcomes.
  • Use tools like LinkedIn Recruiter to proactively source top talent and build diverse pipelines.
  • Translate market research into actionable hiring strategies, including competitor insights, compensation trends, and talent availability.
  • Own the candidate experience, ensuring timely communication, smooth process flow, and alignment with client’s brand.
  • Leverage AI tools and recruiting technology to enhance speed, quality, and efficiency throughout the hiring lifecycle.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement efforts, including interview process design, DEI initiatives, and talent analytics.


Required Qualifications:

  • 5–10 years of professional experience in full-cycle recruiting, ideally across technical and go-to-market roles.
  • Proven success recruiting in the LATAM region, with a strong understanding of local talent markets.
  • Fluent in both English and Spanish; able to communicate effectively across diverse stakeholders.
  • Skilled in sourcing and candidate engagement using tools like LinkedIn Recruiter.
  • Comfortable working independently and managing multiple roles with competing priorities.
  • Experience advising senior stakeholders on hiring decisions, market insights, and strategy.
  • Proficiency with applicant tracking systems; Workday experience is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to incorporate AI tools and technology into recruiting workflows.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Portuguese language proficiency.
  • Prior recruiting experience within SaaS or high-growth product companies.
  • Familiarity with Workday or similar enterprise-level ATS platforms.

title: Analista de Pré-Vendas (SDR)
description:
Quer trabalhar na maior plataforma de saúde do MUNDO?

  • Fazer follow-up constante com os leads, respeitando a cadência definida para cada etapa do funil.
  • Acompanhar métricas e indicadores , propondo otimizações no processo de prospecção e buscando constantemente a melhoria dos resultados.


Qualifications


  • Experiência prévia com prospecção Outbound (SDR ou Pré-vendas), incluindo cold calling.
  • Conhecimento de CRM (Salesforce é um diferencial) e ferramentas de automação de vendas.
  • Foco em resultados , com ambição e motivação para bater metas agressivas.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, essencial para criar rapport e transmitir valor rapidamente.
  • Organização e senso de urgência , importantes para gerenciar diversos leads simultaneamente e não perder oportunidades.
  • Proatividade, resiliência e persuasão , habilidades-chave para contornar objeções e manter ritmo constante de prospecção.
  • Interesse em construir carreira na área de vendas e prospecção de novos negócios, buscando crescimento e aprendizado constante.


Modelo de Trabalho

  • Híbrido para profissionais localizados no Rio de Janeiro.
  • Fornecemos o material necessário, mas, é fundamental ter um local adequado e acesso estável à internet.
  • Remoto para todo o Brasil

Aqui na DOC, valorizamos e celebramos a diversidade em todas as suas formas. Estamos empenhados em atrair talentos diversos, sem importar gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade ou condição física. Estamos comprometidos em construir uma equipe inclusiva e acolhedora, onde cada indivíduo possa fazer bonito, contribuindo com seu melhor.

title: Lead AI Engineer
description:
Lead AI Engineer (3 Positions)

Location: Brazil (Remote / Hybrid based on project needs)


Role Overview

We are seeking highly skilled Lead AI Engineers based in Brazil to design, develop, and deploy scalable AI and machine learning solutions across enterprise systems. The ideal candidates will have strong expertise in Generative AI , RAG architectures , LLMs , and hands-on experience with the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) AI ecosystem.

You will lead AI engineering initiatives, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and drive innovation in intelligent automation, personalization, and data-driven decision-making.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and development of scalable ML models , Generative AI , and RAG-based solutions.
  • Build end-to-end AI/ML pipelines using GCP tools: Vertex AI , Gemini , Vector Search , and Managed Notebooks.
  • Develop intelligent agents and orchestration using LangChain , LangGraph , Google ADK , and CrewAI .
  • Build, fine-tune, and deploy custom LLMs and multimodal AI models.
  • Own technical architecture, solution design, performance optimization, and deployment strategies.
  • Partner with data engineers, cloud teams, and product stakeholders to integrate AI at scale.
  • Implement MLOps best practices for versioning, monitoring, retraining, and governance.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to AI engineering standards and frameworks.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 6+ years of professional experience in AI/ML engineering , including leadership responsibilities.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Generative AI and RAG pipelines .
  • Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn).
  • Deep expertise in the GCP AI/ML stack , including:
  • Vertex AI
  • Gemini
  • Vector Search
  • AI Studio / AI APIs
  • Strong experience with agent-oriented frameworks :
  • LangChain
  • LangGraph
  • CrewAI
  • Google ADK
  • Experience deploying ML models into production using CI/CD and MLOps .
  • Strong understanding of APIs, data engineering fundamentals, cloud-native deployment, and microservices.
  • Excellent communication and ability to lead technical discussions with global teams.


Preferred Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with multi-agent systems and advanced tool orchestration.
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes , Docker , and cloud-native architectures.
  • Understanding of AI security, compliance, and responsible AI frameworks.
  • Experience working in global, distributed engineering teams.


Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field.

title: Creative Content & Concept Specialist - 51437
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are seeking a Creative Content & Concept Specialist with a background in film, video production, or screenplay writing to develop short-form video concepts and narrative structures. This role requires strong storytelling ability, visual thinking, and the skill to translate creative ideas into clear, structured briefs suitable for production and content development workflows.


Day-to-day responsibilities:

Develop short-form video concepts , creative storylines, and scene breakdowns across genres such as drama, comedy, lifestyle, and commercial content.

  • Write clear, production-ready descriptions of scenes, including character actions, camera framing, and sound or environmental cues.
  • Create structured documentation of concepts, ensuring clarity, visual coherence, and emotional consistency.
  • Collaborate with internal creative, production, and quality teams to refine ideas and maintain alignment with content guidelines.
  • Ensure accuracy, continuity, and realism in narrative flow and shot composition.


Manage multiple creative assignments with quick turnarounds while maintaining quality and originality.


Requirements:

Strong background in film, video production, or content creation — understanding of visual storytelling, camera work, and editing principles.

  • Excellent command of English with the ability to write visually descriptive and emotionally engaging content.
  • Knowledge of screenplay formatting and shot structuring (e.g., INT./EXT., scene timing, transitions).
  • Ability to visualize scenes and translate abstract ideas into practical, shootable concepts.
  • Strong attention to detail, creative judgment, and consistency in tone and pacing.
  • Basic familiarity with structured writing formats (Markdown, JSON, TSV, or similar) is a plus.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Film Studies, Mass Communication, English, Media Production, or related fields.
  • 2+ years of experience in creative writing, video production, content development, or screenplay writing.
  • Prior work in short films, advertising content, or storytelling-based projects is highly desirable.
  • Comfortable working under tight timelines with collaborative, cross-functional teams.


Preferred Attributes:

  • Passion for storytelling and cinematic content creation.
  • Strong visual and auditory imagination with attention to human detail.
  • Ability to self-direct, manage multiple creative briefs, and maintain high quality under deadlines.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : Availability of upto 40 hours per week is preferred
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 2 Weeks inital pilot, could extend.
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent an automated analytical challenge .
  • Once you clear the challenge, you will be redirected to a business writing assessment (English) followed by a language proficiency assessment.
  • Once you clear these online assessments, you are ready to go!


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

We’re a new cleantech company spun up by industry experts , hitting the ground running with major deployments in sight. Our mission is simple: build something big—and do it right.


Who We’re Looking For

You’re proactive, organized, and thrive on creating systems that keep things running smoothly. You know how to anticipate needs, take ownership, and execute with precision. You enjoy translating ideas into structured plans, ensuring that the details are handled so leadership can focus on strategy and growth.


You’ll excel in this role if you:

  • Have a strong sense of initiative and can identify what needs to be done without waiting for direction.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently across teams and time zones.
  • Stay calm under pressure, follow through consistently, and take pride in your work.
  • Are motivated by helping build something big from the ground up.

    • Be part of an early-stage cleantech company shaping how energy resilience is delivered to commercial and industrial clients.
    • Work directly with a visionary founder and seasoned industry team.
    • Gain exposure to renewable energy, microgrids, and sustainable tech while helping build foundational systems from the ground up.
    • Join a culture that values professionalism, promptness, and proactivity , and where we win when our customers win.


    Role Responsibilities

    You’ll act as the founder’s operational partner, ensuring focus, organization, and follow-through across daily and weekly priorities.


    • Weekly & Daily Planning: Lead Monday check-ins to align priorities and manage task lists in Workflowy and Google Workspace. Prepare concise Friday summaries and ensure key items progress to completion.


    • Calendar & Coordination: Manage the founder’s schedule, logistics, and meeting flow through Google Calendar and Calendly. Coordinate client meetings, follow-ups, and travel arrangements with precision.


    • Meeting Prep & Research: Prepare “Whispers” (pre-meeting briefs) with relevant background, LinkedIn profiles, and context. Conduct research to support business development or decision-making, and distill long content (e.g., reports, podcasts) into actionable notes.


    • Communication Support: Draft professional correspondence, manage inbox triage, and ensure clear and timely responses based on voice memos or notes.


    • Operations & Documentation: Keep compliance, permit, and project documentation organized. Support customer visits, event logistics, and file management across Google Drive.


    • Process Improvement: Identify and implement ways to simplify, automate, or standardize recurring tasks. Help refine systems and build playbooks that strengthen daily operations.


    • General Support: Help with small personal and family tasks that come up for the CEO such as scheduling a doctor appointment and tracking personal meetings and follow ups.


    Skills & Experience
    • 3+ years as an Executive Assistant, Operations Coordinator, or similar role supporting leadership or founders.
    • Exceptional organizational and follow-through skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
    • Excellent written and verbal English communication.
    • Proficiency in Google Workspace , PowerPoint , Calendly , and productivity tools (Workflowy, Notion, Asana, etc.).
    • Strong research and synthesis skills.
    • Bonus: experience with engineering drawings, compliance workflows, or the solar/battery industry .
    • Tech-savvy mindset, comfortable experimenting with tools and improving processes.

    • Our Values
    • We win when they win – Our clients’ success defines ours.
    • See it through – Follow-through is everything.
    • Make it right – We fix problems, not blame.
    • Build something big – We take pride in creating meaningful impact.
    • Transparency – Honest communication and accountability drive trust.


    Compensation & Employment Type

    Type: Independent contractor, Full-time (40 hours/week)

    Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST

    Compensation: Starting at 1,500 USD/Month, depending on experience

BROKER

Estamos em busca de Broker para nosso time!

QUEM SOMOS:

A Binswanger é uma organização internacional de consultoria imobiliária com mais de 80 anos de tradição. Criada nos Estados Unidos em 1931, a companhia assiste a clientes corporativos em mais de 100 países, nos cinco continentes.

Durante os anos 1990, a consultoria iniciou um programa de expansão internacional, formando alianças estratégicas com organizações imobiliárias em todo o mundo, período em que se estabeleceu também no Brasil, maior mercado imobiliário da América Latina.

Fundada em 1997, a Binswanger Brazil nasceu como escritório regional da rede, e em pouco mais de duas décadas se consolidou como uma das principais fornecedoras de serviços imobiliários para o mercado corporativo brasileiro.

Com sede em São Paulo, a companhia conta atualmente com uma das melhores estruturas imobiliárias em operação no país e oferece assistência de alcance global para todo o território nacional em um balcão único para clientes em diversos setores da economia.

Mais do que atender às necessidades de clientes, a Binswanger Brazil oferece linha completa de soluções imobiliárias e projetos personalizados para atender a todas as etapas dos processos imobiliários de seus parceiros de negócio.

Em 2023 realizamos o que foi um marco significativo para o setor imobiliário, anunciamos a fusão entre a Binswanger Brazil e a SDS Properties. Nossa decisão, motivada pela oportunidade de combinarmos tecnologia, dados, relacionamentos e expertise de equipes altamente referenciadas, buscou potencializar ferramentas, inteligência de mercado, capacidade de inovação e consequentemente apresentar aos nossos clientes o mais alto nível de atendimento em Real Estate do país.

Transações & Assessoria Imobiliária;

Consultoria & Avaliações de Imóveis;

Geo Soluções e Regularização Documental;

Gerenciamento de Projetos e Obras e;

title: Sr. Business Analyst & Product Design
description:

The Business Analyst – Product Designer is a key member of the design team, partnering with business stakeholders and solution architects to deliver value-added features for sales, marketing, and billing teams.   • Strong background in requirements gathering, process mapping, and translating business needs into technical specifications.
  • Hands-on experience with Agile delivery methods, including writing user stories and partnering with Scrum teams.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional and global stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms (Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales strongly preferred) and exposure to cloud-based solutions, APIs, and system integrations.

This role offers the opportunity to work in a global environment, gaining exposure to local and international stakeholders. You will grow both business and technical skillsets while shaping CRM and enterprise applications that drive real impact across unique business streams.


Apply today to join us and build what’s next!.

  • high-quality, maintainable code, and has a keen eye for detail.

glish fluently

An AWS Administrator specializing in Kubernetes, particularly with Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), requires a robust set of skills encompassing both cloud infrastructure and container orchestration

AWS Services:

Proficiency in core AWS services like EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Route 53, EBS, and EFS. Understanding how these integrate with EKS is crucial.


Networking:

Strong understanding of AWS networking concepts, including VPCs, subnets, security groups, NACLs, and routing tables, and how they apply to Kubernetes clusters.


Security:

Knowledge of AWS security best practices, IAM roles and policies, and securing EKS clusters.


Automation & Scripting:

Experience with scripting languages like Python or Bash for automating AWS tasks and managing infrastructure as code (e.g., using CloudFormation or Terraform).

Kubernetes Fundamentals:

Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, including control plane components (API server, etcd, scheduler, controller manager) and worker node components (kubelet, kube-proxy, container runtime).


Containerization:

Expertise in Docker or other container runtimes, including image building, registry management, and container best practices.


Workload Management:

Ability to deploy, manage, and scale applications using Kubernetes objects like Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, and Secrets.


Networking:

Understanding of Kubernetes networking concepts, including CNI plugins, Service networking, Ingress controllers, and DNS resolution within the cluster.


Storage:

Knowledge of Kubernetes storage options, including Persistent Volumes, Persistent Volume Claims, and Storage Classes, particularly with AWS storage integrations.


Monitoring & Logging:

Experience with monitoring and logging solutions for Kubernetes, such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, or AWS CloudWatch Container Insights.


Troubleshooting:

Strong troubleshooting skills to diagnose and resolve issues within EKS clusters and containerized applications.


Helm & Kustomize:

Familiarity with package managers like Helm for deploying and managing Kubernetes applications, and Kustomize for configuration customization.


CI/CD:

Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how to integrate Kubernetes deployments into automated workflows.

description:
Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Business Systems Analyst to join our innovative and dynamic team.

Industry: IT & Services, Data & Analytics.


Business Systems Analyst | About You

As a Business Systems Analyst, you are responsible for supporting the success of a Pay-Per-Use program by identifying, triaging, and resolving data and process discrepancies tied to financial operations. You bring a strong analytical mindset, an understanding of how data flows across systems, and the ability to work cross-functionally across technical and business teams. While you don’t interact directly with external clients, your work plays a critical role in maintaining operational efficiency and enabling clean financial outcomes.   • Troubleshoot and update Tableau reports (10–15 dashboards), ensuring accuracy and relevance of the displayed data.
  • Write and modify SQL queries to investigate issues, validate fixes, and extract data as needed.
  • Collaborate closely with internal finance, technical, and business stakeholders to support billing and revenue-related processes.
  • Contribute to chatbot proof-of-concept development by providing data insights and supporting testing activities.


Business Systems Analyst | Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst, or similar analytical role.

  • Hands-on experience modifying and troubleshooting Tableau dashboards and working with backend data sources.

title: Talent Development Partner
description:

Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.

Recognized by Forbes, The Information, and Fast Company among the world’s top innovators, Turing’s leadership team includes AI technologists from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, McKinsey, Bain, Stanford, Caltech, and MIT. Learn more at


Position Overview

We are seeking a highly creative and hands-on Senior Talent Development Partner to support the establishment of our newly formed Talent Development function. In this role, you will embrace a customer-centric, pragmatic approach, laser-focused on delivering maximum impact through the simplest, highest-quality solutions.

We are here for the growth and development of our customers, Turing Team Members. You will partner closely with leaders to understand their desired development outcomes, time constraints, and needs. Leveraging this knowledge, you will craft relevant, engaging learning content that drives measurable business results for our internal customers. You will seek out simple yet impactful solutions, recognizing that the most compelling learning experiences are often the most practical.


Responsibilities

  • Deeply collaborate with Turing leaders to translate team development needs into compelling, practical learning experiences driving measurable growth.
  • Design and develop engaging, multimedia-rich asynchronous learning content using tools like Articulate, tailoring for diverse styles through simple, high-impact solutions.
  • Serve as the go-to operational owner for the LMS system, curating and maintaining a dynamic, streamlined training catalog. Continuously refine materials for relevance, effectiveness, and alignment with customer needs.
  • Embody an agile, customer-obsessed mindset, rapidly producing high-quality, iterative content elevated by feedback and data.
  • Be a key driving force behind the development, engagement, and iterations of Sales and Engineering bootcamp programs.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience driving the development of L&D initiatives in a high-growth startup or late-stage tech environment.
  • Experienced leveraging LMS systems like Docebo, e-learning platforms, intranet solutions, and instructional design tools like Articulate to deliver impactful learning experiences.
  • Exceptional collaboration and interpersonal skills, with a strong customer-centric approach to building relationships and delivering outstanding service to stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to analyse training metrics, evaluate impact, and translate findings into actionable recommendations to enhance learning solutions.
  • Demonstrated skill in translating business objectives into innovative, engaging, and practical learning solutions that drive measurable results.


Values

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the centre of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed : We move fast, stay agile and favour action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward : We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

description:
Product Manager

About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.


Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!


Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly driven Product Manager to lead the end-to-end development of Pointsville’s digital products. You’ll turn ideas into impactful solutions by connecting business goals, user needs, and technical execution. This role focuses on defining vision, setting priorities, and delivering products that drive growth, innovation, and long-term value across emerging technologies and financial ecosystems.


What You’ll Do

Product Strategy and Planning

  • Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap in alignment with company goals.
  • Conduct market and competitor research to identify new product opportunities and emerging trends.
  • Gather and analyze requirements from users, partners, and internal stakeholders to inform product design and prioritization.
  • Translate business and technical needs into clear product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Manage and continuously refine the product backlog, balancing priorities and timelines across multiple initiatives.


Execution and Delivery

  • Collaborate with UX/UI designers to create user-centric designs and intuitive experiences.
  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure timely and high-quality execution of product features and releases.
  • Lead product launches, define success metrics, and coordinate enablement with marketing, sales, and support teams.


Performance and Improvement

  • Monitor product performance post-launch, analyze user feedback, and drive continuous improvement and iteration.
  • Work closely with compliance and legal teams to ensure all product features adhere to regulatory requirements in the crypto and financial services space.
  • Facilitate cross-functional alignment, ensuring all teams are informed, empowered, and accountable.
  • Support documentation, go-to-market readiness, and internal communication for each product phase.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Business, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 7+ years of experience in product management, preferably in fintech or financial services, with direct crypto experience.
  • Demonstrated success of launching and scaling successful web and/or enterprise products from concept to launch.
  • Experience with varying development methodologies and leading cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong understanding of blockchain, fintech, or emerging financial technologies preferred.
  • Skilled in data-driven decision making using metrics and analytics tools.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to bridge business and technical conversations.
  • High user empathy, strong prioritization abilities, and a proactive, ownership-driven mindset.

One of the largest companies in the world in the Gaming industry is seeking a hands-on Data Architect with DataWarehouse Engineer expertise in Databricks (DBX) and AWS-native data services to spearhead the design and implementation of a new data warehouse instance for a major product line. AWS Native Integration

  • IAM and VPC configuration knowledge for secure cloud integrations
Data Warehousing & Modeling
  • Strong grasp of modern dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas)
  • Experience setting up lakehouse design patterns for mixed workloads
Automation & DevOps
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for data engineering using tools like DBX, Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps
  • Proficient in monitoring tools like CloudWatch, Datadog, or New Relic for data pipelines
Bonus/Nice to Have:
  • Experience supporting gaming or real-time analytics workloads

Self-driven, analytical, and strategic thinkers—who also have excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to develop and execute plans—will succeed in this consultative role.

T

his is not a role in instructional design, curriculum/content development or training delivery or

stakeholders

Qualifications/Requirements

title: Quality Control Lead
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a structured, strict, and technically-minded Head of Quality Assurance who will build and lead one of the most critical operational units in the company.

Scope of responsibility:

  • Management of a team of 30+ remote assistants
  • Quality control of 5,000+ job applications/month (scaling to 10,000+)
  • Direct reporting to the CEO


Context & Challenges

Current situation:

  • 30 assistants submit job applications on behalf of clients
  • Quality is inconsistent—there is no systematic control
  • Many manual review processes → we need automation
  • No structured onboarding for new assistants
  • No clear KPIs or performance-based motivation


What must be built:

Audit the current team

Hire additional assistants

Build a full Quality Assurance system from scratch

Automate quality checks in collaboration with engineering

Implement onboarding, training, and control processes


Key Responsibilities

Build a Quality Assurance system (30%)

First 2 weeks:

  • Audit current assistants
  • Evaluate work quality (accuracy, speed, compliance)
  • Decide who stays, who leaves
  • Create quality criteria and checklists

Ongoing:

  • Implement regular quality audits and spot-checks
  • Establish KPIs (quality, speed, customer satisfaction)
  • Track quality metrics per assistant
  • Identify repeating errors and remove root causes
  • Review difficult cases with the team

Hiring & Onboarding (25%)

Hiring:

  • Design the hiring funnel (screening → test task → interview)
  • Hire new assistants within first 1–2 months
  • Maintain a candidate pipeline (no current churn, but may appear)

Onboarding & training:

  • Build a structured onboarding program (1–2 weeks)
  • Teach systems, standards, and workflows
  • Certify assistants before they start working with clients
  • Create training materials, videos, guides

Automation & Technology (20%)

Work with engineering team:

  • Identify which checks can be automated
  • Create clear requirements and tasks for developers
  • Test and launch automation tools
  • Utilize AI and scripts for monitoring

Automation examples:

  • Automatic validation of application fields
  • Duplicate application detection
  • Performance dashboards and speed tracking
  • Quality alert system
  • Real-time monitoring tools

Team Management (15%)

  • Workload distribution among assistants
  • KPI tracking and performance reviews
  • Escalation handling and issue resolution
  • Motivation and team culture development

People development:

  • Selective 1:1s
  • Coaching low performers
  • Promote top performers into team leads
  • Create internal career paths

Continuous improvement (10%)

  • Identify bottlenecks and improve processes
  • Implement best practices and standardization
  • Maintain operations documentation
  • Work with client complaints, root cause elimination

Requirements

Must-Have:

2+ years managing operational teams

  • Experience managing 20+ employees
  • Built processes from scratch
  • Preferably BPO/outsourcing/call center/EdTech

Strong systems thinking and discipline

  • SOPs, checklists, regulations, compliance
  • Precision and attention to detail
  • Ability to make difficult decisions (terminations, corrective action)

Technical competency

  • Understanding of automation & quality monitoring
  • Ability to write clear requirements for developers
  • Experience with CRM, monitoring dashboards, etc.
  • Nice-to-have: SQL basics, API logic, scripting

Analytical approach

  • Metrics: quality %, speed, productivity, error rate
  • KPI systems and reporting
  • Data-driven decision-making

Experience in hiring & onboarding


Strong Plus:

BPO/outsourcing experience (data entry, support, back office)

Quality automation experience

Technical degree (engineering / CS / math)

Six Sigma/Lean/Kaizen knowledge

Experience scaling teams from 10 → 50+

QA/Quality Management certifications

Experience with distributed remote teams

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior – Kotlin/Java + ReactJS
description:
Sobre nós

A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior para atuar em um projeto temporário (contrato de 3 a 4 meses) , com foco em Kotlin/Java (Spring Boot) no backend e ReactJS no frontend.

Você fará parte de um time técnico de alta performance, responsável por evoluir plataformas escaláveis e de grande impacto, contribuindo tanto na arquitetura e desenvolvimento de APIs e microsserviços quanto na construção de interfaces ricas e intuitivas para o usuário final.

O perfil ideal é alguém que une sólido conhecimento técnico em engenharia de software com visão de produto, boa comunicação e postura colaborativa, capaz de transitar entre camadas da aplicação com fluidez.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações fullstack , com backend em Kotlin/Java (Spring Boot) e frontend em ReactJS .
  • Participar ativamente do desenho e implementação de arquiteturas escaláveis e evolutivas .
  • Criar e manter APIs GraphQL (principal) e REST , assegurando desempenho e segurança.
  • Projetar e implementar comunicação entre microsserviços utilizando gRPC .
  • Escrever código limpo, testável e eficiente , aplicando princípios de engenharia de software.
  • Garantir qualidade de software através de testes automatizados (unitários, integração e E2E).
  • Apoiar revisões de código e disseminar boas práticas no time.
  • Colaborar com as áreas de produto e design para alinhar soluções à melhor experiência do usuário.
  • Investigar novas tecnologias e propor melhorias contínuas.


Essenciais (ênfase da vaga):

  • Experiência sólida em Kotlin e/ou Java com Spring Boot .
  • Forte base em desenvolvimento frontend com ReactJS , incluindo Hooks , Context API , TypeScript e consumo de APIs GraphQL/REST .
  • Domínio de princípios de design de software (SOLID, Clean Code, Clean Architecture).
  • Cultura de testes automatizados (JUnit, Jest, Testing Library).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL) e não-relacionais (MongoDB, Redis) .
  • Vivência em Git , CI/CD pipelines e deploys em ambientes Kubernetes (AWS ou similar) .


Importantes (secundários, mas valorizados):

  • Experiência em arquitetura de microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos .
  • Experiência com mensageria e filas (Kafka, SQS, SNS, RabbitMQ).
  • Conhecimento de componentização e arquitetura microfrontend no frontend.
  • Familiaridade com Node.js


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em projetos de grande escala e ambientes de alta disponibilidade .
  • Atuação prévia em times ágeis com práticas de DevOps .


Entendemos a diversidade como um fator valioso. Todas as nossas oportunidades são Afirmativas para Pessoas com Deficiência.

description:

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people.   • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English

  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

Promover treinamentos, orientar sobre o uso adequado de equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) e monitorar o cumprimento das medidas de segurança.

Realizar vistorias, manter registros e documentação adequada para garantir a conformidade com as exigências legais. Resolução de Problemas: Identificar e resolver problemas e desafios que possam surgir durante a execução da obra. Tomar decisões assertivas, buscando soluções eficientes para garantir a continuidade dos trabalhos dentro dos prazos.
